news.title: JMC students provide front-row coverage of historic Union Jack Classic in London
news.summary_en: As college football made its debut at London's Wembley Stadium, eight William Allen White School of Journalism & Mass Communications students were there to tell the story.

news.title: Indigenous Peoples Day celebration returns to the KU Osher Institute
news.summary_en: The Osher Lifelong Learning Institute at the University of Kansas will host its annual Indigenous Peoples Day Celebration from 9:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. Oct. 12 at the KU Innovation Park Auditorium.

news.title: KU School of Education & Human Sciences launches online master’s in higher education administration
news.summary_en: The University of Kansas School of Education & Human Sciences is launching a fully online M.S.E in Higher Education Administration housed within the Department of Educational Leadership & Policy Studies. The program builds on KU’s established in-person higher education administration graduate degree.

news.title: KU Field Station will host biennial Visitors’ Day Oct. 3
news.summary_en: The University of Kansas Field Station will open its core research area to the public from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. Oct. 3. The event is held every two years, and members of the public will be welcomed behind the scenes to tour restricted-access research areas at the Field Station and learn about ongoing research projects.

news.title: Study finds online educational resources present imperialism in positive light, put students in inappropriate discussions
news.summary_en: University of Kansas researchers have published a study that found popular online educational resources for social studies overwhelmingly present imperialism in a positive light. They also often take a “balance sheet” approach that can ask inappropriate questions of students.
